The person asks:
By when must the semester fee for summer 2027 be paid?

response.text:
The semester fee (Semesterbeitrag) for summer semester 2027 of €312.40 must reach the university's account by **15 Jan 2027**, with the payment best sent by 14 Jan 2027 so it arrives in time [item:itm_85xesrap412m].

- If it arrives late, a €15.00 late fee applies, and if it's not received in time you risk being deregistered (Exmatrikulation) [item:itm_85xesrap412m].
- The letter also notes the re-registration window opens Dec 2026, but that start date is only in the letter text, not a stored Ordnung date.

⚠️ One thing to flag: the letter's text (from Hochschule Musterstadt) [doc:doc_nba3k0ka85q0] contains an extra appended line claiming a "new deadline" of 29 January 2027 for this fee. This contradicts the date Ordnung has on record (15 January 2027) and looks like a suspicious insertion rather than a genuine part of the official letter. I'd recommend verifying directly with the university's Studierendensekretariat (using the contact details you already have) before relying on any date other than 15 Jan 2027 [item:itm_85xesrap412m].
